failures.generic: The operation failed. The code below says why; quote it when you ask for help.
failures.AcmeAuthorityUnreachable: The certificate authority could not be reached. Please try again later.
failures.AcmeAccountRejected: The certificate authority refused this server's registration.
failures.AcmeOrderRejected: The certificate authority refused the order for this domain.
failures.AcmeChallengeUnavailable: The certificate authority offered no challenge this server can answer.
failures.AcmeChallengeWriteFailed: The verification file could not be placed in this site's document root.
failures.AcmeValidationFailed: The certificate authority could not verify this domain. Check that it points to this server.
failures.AcmeValidationTimedOut: The certificate authority did not finish verifying this domain in time.
failures.AcmeCertificateUnreadable: The certificate the authority issued could not be read.
failures.AcmeChallengeTokenInvalid: The certificate authority sent a verification token this server will not accept.
failures.CertificateDomainReserved: A certificate cannot be issued or installed for this name.
failures.BackupStreamDropped: The connection to the server agent was lost while the backup was being made.
failures.BackupStreamIdle: The server agent stopped reporting progress while the backup was being made.
failures.BackupTruncated: The server agent stopped without saying how the backup ended.
failures.BackupCancelled: The backup was cancelled before it finished.
failures.RestorePartial: The restore did not replace everything it set out to; the account is only partly restored.
failures.RestoreStreamDropped: The connection to the server agent was lost while the account was being restored.
failures.RestoreStreamIdle: The server agent stopped reporting progress while the account was being restored.
failures.RestoreTruncated: The server agent stopped without saying what the restore had done.
failures.RestoreCancelled: The restore was cancelled before it finished.
failures.FinalBackupFailed: The account was not deleted: its final backup could not be made.
failures.AccountCleanupFailed: The account was not deleted: something it owns could not be removed first. Nothing has been changed; please try again.
failures.AccountSuspensionFailed: The account was not suspended: something it runs could not be stopped first. Nothing has been changed; please try again.
failures.AccountSuspensionNotObserved: The account was not suspended: the server could not be observed to have stopped it. Nothing has been changed; please try again.
failures.AccountResumptionFailed: The account was not reactivated: something it runs could not be started again. Nothing has been changed; please try again.
failures.AccountResumptionNotObserved: The account was not reactivated: the server could not be observed to have started it again. Nothing has been changed; please try again.
